segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin (including one describing dull, dry winter skin) report the pads help with dryness and leave skin feeling nourished and hydrated.
segments.sensitive: A reviewer describing very sensitive, reactive, acne-prone skin reports fast visible improvement in texture within days, with no irritation.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s describe brighter, more even, glowing skin and fading of an age spot.
segments.combination: One reviewer with acne-prone skin (and visible pores) reports minimized pores and reduced peeling once paired with a better moisturizer, alongside a glowing look.

concerns.aging: A 46-year-old and a reviewer in her 40s report brighter, more even-looking mature skin, with one noting an age spot almost completely faded.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe dull, dry skin becoming more hydrated, plump and glowing after use, including through winter dryness.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with acne-prone, reactive skin reports mild peeling initially, attributed to winter weather, which resolved after switching to a stronger moisturizer.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation and post-breakout marks, including one age spot nearly gone; one reviewer's hands showed no visible change yet.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or acne-scarred skin, including a teenager with dull, acne-filled, scarred skin, report glowing, clearer-looking skin; one notes needing to space out use to every other day due to acne-prone skin.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports visibly minimized pores after combined use with other products in the line.

extraits.texte: These have my 46 year old skin glowing and my son's 18 year old dull, acne filled & scarred skin glowing. I could see a difference after the first use, seriously.

My skin was dull, rough, pores looked terrible, and overall my skin tone was uneven. I bought these and within tow days seen a hige difference for the better. My skin had this amazing glow, it was soft to the touch and dark spots lightened. I only use ceravae face wash and these toner pads daily. For reference im 40+ AA women, I will keep buying these over and over my skin has never looked and felt so good.

extraits.titre: Changed my skin for the better
extraits.texte: Okay, I have never written a review in my life but I feel the need to write one for these toner pads. My skin is very sensitive, acne prone and reactive. I usually know when a new product is good or bad for my skin within the first 12 hours of using it because it reacts SO fast to products. Ive been using these toner pads, the pink serum, the vitamin C moisturizer and and collagen mask for over a week now and my skin has completely changed. The texture I've had on my forhead, nose and chin that I've had since I was 13 is mostly gone within the first few days of using these pads. I'm a licensed esthetican as well and as a skincare professional, I highly reccomend this entire brand.

Ok so i'm gonna be real with all of you I have a problem when it comes to shopping. I feel like I've bought every skin care/makeup combo out there and when I tell you these pads are life changing I am not exaggerating. I have been using these, the medicube jelly cream and the Fresh black tea age renewal cream for the past couple of days and my pores have visible minimized and my skin is glowing! Now i do want to say i noticed some mild peeling but that's probably because of the winter weather and once i purchased a better moisturizer that went away. Overall, i highly recommend these pads. They have been a gamechanger!

these medicube Deep vita C pads are so good! they leave my skin looking like glass! I use every other day instead of everyday, but that's just because I have acne prone skin. the reason why these are a little too good is because now I have to keep repurchasing these pads!!
These have helped so much with my dry skin in the winter. Will purchase over and over. Such a great price point too.

extraits.titre: First toner pad I have tried
extraits.texte: This seems to be helping my hyper pigmentation my skin is looking great. I use it in the morning on my face neck and back of hands. My hands i cant notice a difference yet, but my face is more even and glowing. My one age spot is almost completely gone. I will repurchase.
